items.title: Jio IPO expected launch date and price, latest GMP price, Reliance shareholder quota - What we know so far
items.summary: As per media reports, Jio Platforms IPO is set for subscription on 21 October, with shares listing on 28 October. The offering could comprise 27 crore shares and support Reliance Jio's debt repayment. Eligible shareholders can apply under a reserved category based on undetermined record dates.

items.title: GST Council to consider 17-day refund timeline, faster registrations
items.summary: The GST Council is set to consider measures to speed up refunds and GST registrations, with a proposed 17-day refund timeline and greater automation for registrations. It may also ease compliance for small businesses selling across states through e-commerce platforms, simplify registration cancellations and expand input tax credit eligibility.

items.title: RBI hike reinforces stock selection, not broad equity caution: Ajit Mishra
items.summary: Going ahead, crude oil prices, food inflation, the rupee and global monetary conditions will be the key variables to watch.

items.title: Marsons share price rallies 15% today | What's behind the jump? Check share performance
items.summary: Marsons share price have shown a mixed performance across different timeframes. The stock has gained 11.28% over the past week, indicating a strong recent recovery.

items.title: ESDS share price hits 5% upper circuit after 7-day losing streak: What fuelled rally?
items.summary: ESDS Software Solution's stock rebounded by 5% to ₹1,359 on October 7, ending a seven-session decline. Despite recent losses, shares remain 217% above their issue price, buoyed by positive ratings upgrades and ongoing growth in cloud-related revenue.

items.title: RBI hikes rate, but analysts see shift to ‘calibrated tightening’ as bigger takeaway. How can this impact markets?
items.summary: RBI’s 25-bps repo rate hike to 5.50% was largely expected, but its shift to ‘calibrated tightening’ surprised markets and signals that near-term rate cuts are unlikely. Analysts expect selective pressure on rate-sensitive sectors, while banks with stronger balance sheets may remain relatively better placed amid rising inflation and crude prices.

items.title: RBI has space for more rate hikes despite growth cheer
items.summary: Quickening inflation, stoked by oil prices and El Nino, could force policymakers to harden further

items.title: Trent’s Rs 1.80 lakh crore rout from peak: Has Q2 just flipped the script for Tata group’s retail crown jewel?
items.summary: In Q2FY27, Trent demonstrated impressive financial performance, achieving a remarkable 23% increase in revenue compared to the previous year. This achievement is particularly noteworthy given the challenges other retailers faced during the festive period. With continued expansion in store locations for both Zudio and Westside, analysts are split on future prospects, balancing optimism for recovery against caution as…

items.title: HDFC Bank shares drop 15% in 3 months since Q1 results. Will Q2 earnings bring redemption as leadership cloud clears?
items.summary: HDFC Bank shares have witnessed a significant decline, dropping nearly 15% in the last quarter following unsatisfactory first-quarter results. With Anup Bagchi now at the helm as CEO, leadership transitions are anticipated to impact the bank's trajectory. Investors are eagerly awaiting the Q2 earnings report on October 17, hoping it will shed light on growth strategies.

items.title: RBI MPC Meeting Oct 2026 Live: RBI MPC hikes repo rate by 25 bps to 5.5%, changes stance to 'calibrated tightening'
items.summary: The central bank raised its FY2026–27 growth forecast from 6.7% to 7.1%, while lifting projected inflation to 5.2%

items.title: Axis, AU Bank, PNB: Brokerages identify 5 bank stocks after RBI hikes rate
items.summary: Axis Bank, Karnataka Bank, PNB, AU Bank and City Union Bank are the 5 bank stocks identified by Ajit Mishra of Religare Broking and Hitesh Rathi of Angel One based on the technical chart set-up.

items.title: RBI’s hawkish shift signals more rate hikes ahead, say Economists
items.summary: MPC raises repo rate by 25 bps, changes stance to calibrated tightening; economists see clear signal that easing cycle is over and further hikes of at least 50 bps remain on the table

items.title: Policy Dialogue: RBI builds financial market platform to debate and discuss
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is forming a Financial Market Consultative Committee for better engagement with market participants. This committee aims to address policy and operational matters related to financial markets. It will include discussions on the money market, government securities, and foreign exchange markets. The committee will also look into the infrastructure surrounding these markets for improvements.

items.title: RBI's rate cut pre-emptive measure than start of hike cycle: Sujan Hajra
items.summary: A 25-bps hike today may reduce some near-term policy flexibility, but it also lowers the risk of having to undertake a much sharper adjustment later, said Sujan Hajra, chief economist at Anand Rathi

items.title: Monetary Policy shifts gear, lays emphasis on containing supply-side shocks
items.summary: The Governor acknowledged that price pressures are increasingly extending beyond food and fuel.

items.title: India’s trade deals can boost jobs, attract investment: Commerce Secy Rajesh Agarwal
items.summary: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal highlighted India's potential to grow its participation in global value chains. He noted that the current participation rate has increased significantly over the past decade. Agarwal emphasized the importance of free trade agreements with developed economies for facilitating trade and attracting investments.

items.title: Reliance Jio IPO: Rs 37,700 crore mega issue, full schedule & 5 must-know details
items.summary: Jio Platforms is gearing up for what could be India’s biggest IPO yet, with a Rs 37,700 crore issue expected around Dussehra. The IPO timeline, likely price band, key dates, allotment and listing plans are all explained in this video. Here’s everything investors need to know about Jio’s much-awaited mega IPO.

items.title: Penny stock under ₹10 hits 5% upper circuit after this fundraising update | Do you own?
items.summary: Elitecon International shares reached its 5% upper circuit on October 7 after announcing a board meeting for October 12 to discuss a fundraising proposal. The company recorded substantial growth in FY26, with net profit increasing to ₹185.06 crore and revenue surging to ₹5,074.80 crore.

items.title: Nifty earnings seen rising 27%, strongest growth in 17 quarters in Q2: Motilal Oswal
items.summary: India’s Q2FY27 earnings season is expected to mark a strong recovery in corporate profitability, with Nifty 50 earnings projected to grow 27% YoY, the highest in 17 quarters, according to Motilal Oswal. While resilient domestic fundamentals and liquidity support the outlook, persistent FII outflows, weak foreign investor sentiment and global macroeconomic pressures remain key challenges for Indian equities.

items.title: RBI raises policy rates 25 bps to tame inflation as India hurdles growth barriers
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has unanimously decided to increase the benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points. This decision was made amid rising inflation projections and increasing US bond yields. The bank also revised its economic growth forecast for FY27 to 7.1%, indicating strong economic activity. Inflation is expected to reach an average of 5.2% through FY27, affecting consumer prices.

items.title: Kanohar Electricals soars 20%; stock up 79% from IPO price in three weeks
items.summary: Kanohar Electricals' share price hit a new high of ₹1,129.35 on the BSE in Wednesday's intra-day deals, having zoomed 79% from its issue price of ₹632 per share.

items.summary: Asset Reconstruction Company shares opened at ₹149 against their previous close of ₹145.70 and jumped 10% to their upper price band and all-time high of ₹160.25.

items.summary: EQT, Carlyle, Blackstone and ChrysCapital are amon eyeing a stake in Gemson, with the deal likely to help expand capabilities

items.title: RBI MPC speech: Weak monsoon, strong El Niño, rabi season, global crude prices - What Governor Sanjay Malhotra conveyed
items.summary: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra announced that the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) has hiked the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, marking the first increase in over three years, to control rising inflation amid a continuing crisis in West Asia.

items.summary: While the increase has been predominantly on account of higher inflation in food and fuel groups, core inflation has also picked up indicating some signs of widening price pressures

items.title: Paramount closes Warner merger in historic Hollywood deal
items.summary: The new company, which will be called Skydance, combines two of the five largest Hollywood film studios, uniting major franchises such as Harry Potter and Mission Impossible

items.title: Mint Explainer | What RBI's rate hike means for retail borrowers and lenders
items.summary: For retail borrowers whose floating-rate loans are linked to the repo rate, either monthly payouts will rise, or the tenure of their repayments will increase. Lenders will soon start passing on the revised interest rates.
